name: Rage Bait VR
summary:
Your chat has terrible ideas. Make them happen.

Become a street streamer in Rage Bait, a chaotic VR sandbox where every passerby is a chance to put on a show. Be generous, pull outrageous pranks, or become an absolute menace.
